full_text:
Sub-300ms Voice AI latency is no longer a luxury—it is the baseline requirement.

Standard REST LLM calls take 1.8 seconds. Users abandon voice calls if response pause exceeds 500ms.

Combining Deepgram Nova-2 streaming STT with Groq Llama-3.3-70b speculative decoding achieves sub-220ms glass-to-glass turn latency.

Here is our production setup:
1. Deepgram WebSocket STT (<100ms)
2. Groq Llama-3.3-70b (<70ms)
3. ElevenLabs TTS (<80ms)

What bottleneck is currently slowing down your conversational voice stack?
